grades.quote: This register enables supervisor-level overflow interrupt handler software to quickly and easily determine which counter(s) have overflowed (without needing to make an execution environment call or series of calls ultimately up to M-mode).
grades.reason: Provides auxiliary information about reading counter overflow status, not selecting events or reading event counts.

grades.quote: The cycle and instret counters serve to support user mode self-profiling usages, wherein a user can read the counter(s) twice and compute the delta(s) to evaluate user software performance and behavior.
grades.reason: Explains measuring performance using counter-read differences and discusses privilege filtering, but does not explain event selection.
